tools.name: member_savings_balance_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a credit-union member in the MeridianCore servicing console and return the current balance and status of their Regular Savings account.

Returns on success: current_savings_balance (decimal), savings_account_status (string), member_name (string).
May instead return status='business_outcome' with one of: member_not_found, executive_services_restricted.
Surface: Meridian Systems MeridianCore Servicing. Artifact status: approved, version 1.0.0.

member_id.description: The member number to look up, as printed on the member record.

tools.name: member_stop_payment_request
tools.description:
Record a stop payment against a member's share draft in the MeridianCore servicing console and return the host reference number from the confirmation screen. The committing control is human-only under the default safety profile, so an unattended replay pauses for an operator before the request is recorded.

Returns on success: stop_payment_reference (string), request_status (string).
May instead return status='business_outcome' with one of: member_not_found, invalid_check_number_format.
Surface: Meridian Systems MeridianCore Servicing. Artifact status: approved, version 1.0.0.

member_id.description: The member number the stop payment is recorded against.

check_number.description: The number of the check to stop, as printed on the draft.

check_amount.description: The amount of the check, in dollars and cents.

requested_by.description: The name of the person who asked for the stop payment.

current_savings_balance.description: Current Balance shown for the Regular Savings account

savings_account_status.description: Status shown for the Regular Savings account row

member_name.description: Member's name from the member record

stop_payment_reference.description: The Reference Number printed on the Stop Payment confirmation screen

request_status.description: The Request Status shown on the Stop Payment confirmation screen
